title: C: FizzBuzz
description: Classic FizzBuzz: print numbers 1-30, replacing multiples of 3 with 'Fizz', 5 with 'Buzz', and both with 'FizzBuzz'.

steps.title: FizzBuzz Loop
steps.description: Loop from 1 to 30. For each number: if divisible by 3 and 5 print 'FizzBuzz', if by 3 print 'Fizz', if by 5 print 'Buzz', otherwise print the number. Print each on a new line.
hints: Use a for loop from 1 to 30.
